prompt:
A black-and-white CHILDREN'S COLORING BOOK page, square 1:1, 1080x1080.

THIS IS A MACRO CLOSE-UP SHOT, LIKE A ZOOMED-IN PHONE CAMERA PHOTO TAKEN TOO CLOSE. The subject is so close to the "camera" that it does NOT fully fit in the frame: the top of the phage character's round head is CUT OFF by the TOP edge, and the round bacterium-planet character is CUT OFF by the LEFT, RIGHT and BOTTOM edges. There must be ZERO empty white background space visible anywhere in the image — every part of the 1080x1080 canvas is covered by either black line-art or white space that belongs INSIDE a drawn shape. If you can see plain empty background at any edge, the drawing is WRONG — redo it bigger and closer.

SCENE (draw it oversized, then let the frame crop it): A cheerful little bacteriophage character with a SOFT ROUND BALL-SHAPED HEAD (round in every direction, NOT a tall elongated capsule) with big happy cartoon eyes and a big smile, sitting low on a short stubby round body that sits close to the ground — this character should look small, round and squat, never tall. Under the body, SIX SHORT, BLUNT, ROUNDED leg-stubs barely peek out and rest gently on the surface below — tiny rounded rubber-foot bumps, evenly spaced, each one very short and stubby (much shorter than the round head is wide), touching a big round smiling bacterium-planet character (standing in for E. coli, drawn as a giant friendly circle/oval with a cheerful little face and a small open hatch/door on its side). With one short rounded arm, the phage character hands a small rolled-up scroll (a freshly copied note, tied with a little bow) through the bacterium's open hatch. Both characters are smiling. No fight, no forcing, no bursting, no popping — the hatch is already open and welcoming. Keep the background almost bare aside from two or three simple rounded sparkle-free dots near the scroll — no other objects.

STYLE — coloring book line art: BOLD, THICK, EVEN BLACK OUTLINES on pure WHITE. Every shape fully closed. NO shading, NO grey tones, NO hatching, NO gradients, NO colour fill, NO solid black fills anywhere (eyes may have a small solid pupil only). Simple, cheerful, chunky shapes with open white space INSIDE each shape for colouring.

STRICTLY FORBIDDEN:
- Any visible empty white background, wall, sky or margin space — the artwork must be so zoomed-in and oversized that it touches or crosses every one of the four edges, with elements literally cut off by the edges.
- ANY starburst, radiating burst, sparkle rays, sunbeam rays, radiating speed lines, or a halo of rays anywhere — this applies especially to the six leg-stubs, which must be SHORT, BLUNT and ROUNDED, tucked close under the body, never long, never pointed, never drawn as spikes or thin rays fanning out from a hub.
- More or fewer than six leg-stubs, or legs of uneven, spiky, or thread-like shape.
- A tall or elongated head or body — the phage character must read as small, round and squat, not lander-shaped or tower-shaped.
- ANY rectangle, box outline, picture frame, panel edge, border line or vignette around the whole picture.
- NO text, letters, numbers, words, captions, labels, signatures or watermarks.
- NO speech bubble or thought bubble (added separately afterwards).
- NO fighting, no bursting/popping cell, no bite marks, no blood, no medical tools, no sick or sad character, no needles.
- NO full human figure or human face anywhere.
- The phage character never bites, stings or forces its way in — the hatch is already open and welcoming, and the whole scene is a gentle, happy delivery.
